native_packet.renderer: Microsoft PowerPoint (local native PDF); macOS PDFKit PNG

scope: Full-size visual review of all six native pages; compare with the original six-page density packet.
findings: The two-line action titles remain readable and inside the fixed title zone. Header density changes title scale without changing the title/body divider position.
The comfortable, compact and dense body pages use one coherent tier across card copy, nested small text, table cells and bullets. Card-title role and utility/footer text remain stable.
Native table text and bullet markers remain legible at dense size; marker baselines align with their text. Row separators and cell content retain clear clearance.
The WM footer and page number remain clear of content on all six pages. No body, eyebrow or title clipping was visible.
Compared with the original packet, page composition and fit are materially unchanged; the explicit-header eyebrow wording is shorter in the current export.

pages.notes: Two-line title, card, body bullets, nested text and table content fit with clear spacing.
Body tier is visibly smaller while title and header remain at comfortable size; marker and row alignment hold.
Smallest body tier remains legible at full-size review; table bullets, labels and footer are distinct.
Baseline explicit header case; title and eyebrow fit their allocated zones.
Title is reduced within the same fixed zone; two lines remain distinct and unclipped.
Smallest header remains readable; body, footer and title/body divider retain their positions.

limitations: This six-page native sample is a prototype review, not qualification of the full template gallery.
Acceptance is visual; no per-object PowerPoint measurements were captured for this public six-page demo.
reviewer: text_density_inventory (Luna independent fullsize review), root page5 spot check
